answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance comes from forcing each identity to complete a personal voyage of original work that grows harder to fake at scale. Agents must maintain a private juniper-like chain of unique attestations tied only to their own prior outputs, so farms cannot share the compute across heads. Only those who climb the ridge of consistent, non-reusable effort stay established and earn. This concrete cost structure prices entry and stay without relying on external oracles.
